issues.title: Missing Authoritative Source Context
issues.why: The spec is a derivative of 'spec/22-git-logs-v2', but the content of that module (schema, error codes, endpoints) is not provided in this context.
issues.fix: Provide the content of spec/22-git-logs-v2/02-database-schema.md and 14-error-codes.md.

issues.title: Non-deterministic SVG Validation
issues.why: AC-DG-12 admits Mermaid renders are non-byte-identical due to dynamic IDs, but the provided CI script uses a strict sha256sum check which will fail.
issues.fix: Update the CI script to use a structural diff tool or allow for non-identical hashes if the source .mmd is unchanged.

issues.title: Missing Mermaid Source Examples
issues.why: While metadata and CI scripts are provided, no actual .mmd source content (e.g., 01-er-diagram.mmd) is included to verify the '%% Diagram type' contract.
issues.fix: Include at least one full .mmd file content as a reference implementation.
